# WindowDefinition

- Namespace: `PPDS.Dataverse.Query.Planning.Nodes`
- Assembly: `PPDS.Dataverse`
- Kind: Class

## Summary

Defines a single window function to compute within a ClientWindowNode.
Uses compiled delegates instead of AST types.
